Message:
ALSA: hda/realtek: Enable ASUS X441MB and X705FD headset MIC with ALC256

The ASUS laptop X441MB and X705FD with ALC256 cannot detect the headset
MIC until ALC256_FIXUP_ASUS_MIC_NO_PRESENCE quirk applied.
